name: Hexworth Blink — Arduino Mega 2560

primary.label: Install Arduino IDE
instructions: Click "Install Arduino IDE" to download the official IDE for your operating system.
Download blink.ino from this page and open it in the IDE (File > Open).
Plug your Mega 2560 into your computer over USB.
In the IDE: Tools > Board > Arduino AVR Boards > Arduino Mega or Mega 2560.
Tools > Port > select the port your Mega is on (usually labelled with "Arduino").
Click the right-arrow Upload button. The IDE compiles and flashes the sketch in under 30 seconds.
After upload, the on-board LED next to pin 13 blinks once per second.

secondary.label: Use Arduino Web Editor (cloud)
instructions: Click "Use Arduino Web Editor" to open Arduino's cloud editor.
Sign in or create a free Arduino Cloud account.
Drag blink.ino into the editor or paste the contents into a new sketch.
Select board "Arduino Mega or Mega 2560" and your USB port.
Click Upload. The browser flashes the sketch over WebSerial.
Note: this path requires the Arduino Create Agent on Windows (one-time install).

verify: On-board LED next to pin 13 blinks at 1 Hz. Open Serial Monitor at 115200 baud to see "LED on" / "LED off" log lines.
description: First sketch for the Arduino Mega 2560 — confirms your board, toolchain, and upload path all work. Blinks the on-board LED at 1 Hz. Primary path is the Arduino IDE (most reliable, works offline). Secondary path is Arduino Web Editor (cloud-based, requires a free account but flashes over WebSerial).
